mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today is balanced dish: we have 49 degrees with overcast skies near Verona City Hall and a Waning Crescent moon.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous vote, establishing a long-term roadmap for sustainable growth, housing, and infrastructure. Additionally, the city continues to maintain a strong financial position with its Moody is Aa1 rating.

You have plenty to look forward to, including live music at Bailey is Run and Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, be sure to check out the Dane County Farmer is Market at the Capitol square and the international puppet festival at Century School Park.

A notable incident occurred on September 28 when a 16-year-old operator of an e-bike was involved in a collision with an SUV after engaging in reckless driving; the juvenile was cited for his actions.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for our flavor of the day, OREO Cookie Overload. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:30 PM.
